verdict.rationale: AgentOS explicitly offers 'building cashflow reports' and analysis-style skills driven by AI agents reading account data, which maps to AI-generated insights/suggestions from financial data. However, this is delivered via external agent integrations (CLI, MCP server, Claude Code/Cursor plugins) rather than a native in-app insights panel for end users inside the Airwallex product itself. Missing for 10: evidence of a built-in dashboard/UI surface showing AI-generated insights without external agent setup, and independent user reports of such insights in practice.
